# pi-ecosystem-mcap

> Independent analysis of Pi ecosystem market-cap mechanics at activation — confirmed facts vs speculation.

Live site: https://aybvip.github.io/pi-ecosystem-mcap/
GitHub: https://github.com/aybvip/pi-ecosystem-mcap

## Quick rule
- A claim is CONFIRMED only if stated in an official Pi Network or partner source.
- Otherwise → it is SPECULATION.

## Key confirmed facts
- Pi is stated as the primary cryptocurrency across the network's processes.
- OUSD (Open Standard) is a confirmed partner, playing a complementary role — not a replacement for Pi.
- CiDi Games is an official Pi Network Ventures investee with a live in-ecosystem economy (CiDiCoin, Elf Sigil, CiDiScore).
- "All assets convert directly to Pi" is NOT found as a mandatory official rule.

## Documents index
- docs/CONFIRMED.md — confirmed vs unconfirmed table with sources
- docs/MARKETCAP_IN_PI.md — the numeraire concept: why "measured in Pi" makes sense
- docs/OUSD.md — OUSD role, value freezing, complementary vs replacement
- docs/PIDEX.md — order book, liquidity, speed, tracking sold assets
- docs/LIQUIDITY.md — AMM vs Order Book, Spread, Depth, Slippage explained simply
- docs/FIRST_MINUTES.md — what happens in the first 60 seconds when a new asset hits PiDEX
- docs/CASE_CIDI.md — live case study: CiDi Games / ELF (CiDiCoin, Elf Sigil, CiDiScore)
- docs/TOKENS_NFTS_AI.md — AI tokens and NFT behavior — why Pi is typically the first destination
- docs/SPECULATION.md — clear separation between fact and speculation
- docs/SOURCES.md — all official sources with links
